mapper.select: SELECT * FROM message WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (sender_id, sender_name, receiver_id, receiver_name, content, message_type, file_name, file_path, file_size, is_ai_reply, reply_to_id, sender_ip) VALUES (#{senderId}, #{senderName}, #{receiverId}, #{receiverName}, #{content}, #{messageType}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{isAiReply}, #{replyToId}, #{senderIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE message SET is_recalled = 1, recalled_at = NOW(), content = #{content}, original_content = #{originalContent} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE message SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM message WHERE receiver_id IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
